limitations: This is a visual quality sample, not independent validation of the full 1,000-level batch. It samples the first, middle, and last available level in each of the four shards (12 distinct levels total).
All 12 selected original images were inspected directly. No labels were accepted and no candidate shard was edited.
The batch validation lists no repeated_observations, so there were no explicitly highlighted repeated-category descriptions to add to this sample.

The sampled candidate rows have verified_difficulty and verified_strategy set to unknown and both speculative hypotheses null. Initial-board screenshots do not establish measured difficulty, success rate, or optimal strategy.
The ratings assess the sampled observations and geometry tags only; they do not establish the accuracy of unsampled descriptions, tags, or hypotheses.
